t0.text: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment. When is the doctor available tomorrow?

t1.text: Namaste! Tomorrow — Saturday — Dr. Rao is available from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM. What time would you like?

t3.text: Booked — tomorrow at 9:00 AM with Dr. Rao. I'll send a reminder the day before. Anything else?
